entries.f24b35d805395d04: Under its management philosophy, 'Protecting people's lives. Protecting people's livelihoods. Protecting the environment that nurtures people,' the company positions insecticides, household products and gardening products as its core businesses, and provides products that contribute to building a society in which people around the world can continue to live safely and comfortably. Measures against infectious diseases transmitted by mosquitoes are a practice of SDGs Goal 3, Target 3.3, and the company provides high-efficacy, high-quality products suited to each country, and is advancing the strengthening of its management base and the acceleration of business development in line with the geographic expansion of its business areas and its European operations. One of its management targets is a first-year new product sales contribution ratio of 15% or more, and against a consolidated revenue target of ¥77,100 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, the result was ¥77,366 million.
